t: Free system dynamics software for building and running simulations.
steps: Fill in the download form on the Ventana Systems site with an email address.
Open the email with download instructions.
Ask IT to approve the install.
Install it on Windows 10 or 11 or macOS 12 or later.
Open a sample model from the library.
Run the simulation and look at the graphs.
Build a simple stock and flow model of your own.
